class.name: RestructuredtextLabel
class.brief_description: A scrollable control for displaying reStructuredText documents.
class.description: [RestructuredtextLabel] renders imported [RSTDocument] resources or raw reStructuredText text. It supports headings and anchors, paragraphs, lists, code blocks, tables, admonitions, images, toctrees, document links, downloads, text selection, search, and external HTTP links. Configure [code]dockit/rst/document_roots[/code] in Project Settings to generate the small reference index used by cross-document [code]:ref:[/code] links and toctree navigation. Relative resources resolve from the source [code].rst[/code] file when one is assigned; otherwise [member access] and [member root_subfolder] define their base directory. Internal document links emit [signal link_pressed]. Connect to that signal to load another document and scroll to any fragment in the destination.

method.name: activate_link_uri
method.description: Emits [signal link_pressed] for [param uri], scrolls to a matching anchor when it points into the current document, and opens HTTP or HTTPS links when [member open_external_links] is enabled.

method.name: clear_document
method.description: Clears the current document and its rendered content.

method.name: clear_selection
method.description: Clears the current text selection.

method.name: get_anchors
method.description: Returns the anchors available in the rendered document.

method.name: get_content_height
method.description: Returns the rendered content height in pixels.

method.name: get_content_margin
method.description: Returns the uniform margin around the document content.

method.name: get_document
method.description: Returns the current document resource, or [code]null[/code] when rendering raw text.

method.name: get_extra_font_size
method.description: Returns the additional font size applied to rendered text.

method.name: get_access
method.description: Returns the default source used to resolve relative resource paths.

method.name: get_resource_base_dir
method.description: Returns the base directory used to resolve relative images, documents, and downloads. The current document source directory takes precedence over [member root_subfolder].

method.name: get_root_subfolder
method.description: Returns the root folder used when resolving relative paths without a source document.

method.name: get_menu
method.description: Returns the internal [PopupMenu] used for the context menu. The menu is created on first access.

method.name: get_open_external_links
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if activated HTTP and HTTPS links are opened with the system's default application.

method.name: get_rendered_block_count
method.description: Returns the number of rendered top-level blocks.

method.name: get_selected_text
method.description: Returns the selected document text.

method.name: get_rst_text
method.description: Returns the raw reStructuredText text currently displayed.

method.name: has_anchor
method.description: Returns whether the rendered document contains [param anchor].

method.name: load_rst_file
method.description: Loads an imported [code].rst[/code] resource or reads a source file and displays it. Relative paths use [member access] and [member root_subfolder], unless the current document supplies a source directory. Returns an [enum Error] code.

method.name: is_context_menu_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the right-click context menu is enabled. The default value is [code]false[/code].

method.name: is_deselect_on_focus_loss_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current selection is cleared when the control loses focus.

method.name: is_drag_and_drop_selection_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if selected text can be dragged to Godot controls that accept text drag-and-drop data.

method.name: is_fit_content_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the control reports its rendered content height as its minimum height.

method.name: is_menu_visible
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the context menu is currently visible.

method.name: is_scroll_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the internal vertical scroll bar is active.

method.name: is_selection_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if text selection is enabled.

method.name: get_word_selection_mode
method.description: Returns the word boundary algorithm used for double-click text selection.

method.name: is_shortcut_keys_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the configured Copy and Select All keyboard shortcuts are enabled.

method.name: menu_option
method.description: Handles a menu option by its identifier. Use the constants from [enum MenuItems].

method.name: refresh
method.description: Rebuilds the layout for the current document text.

method.name: resolve_document_path
method.description: Resolves [param path] relative to the current document's source directory, or to [member access] and [member root_subfolder] when no source directory is available.

method.name: render_text
method.description: Displays raw reStructuredText from [param text]. Relative resources require a source document to be set through [method set_document].

method.name: resolve_link_uri
method.description: Resolves a [code]:doc:[/code], [code]:ref:[/code], or [code]:download:[/code] target to a resource URI.

method.name: scroll_to_anchor
method.description: Scrolls to [param anchor], placing it at [param align] of the viewport. Returns [code]false[/code] when the anchor is not present.

method.name: scroll_to_search_result
method.description: Scrolls to the current search result, placing it at [param align] of the viewport. Returns [code]false[/code] when there is no current result.

method.name: search
method.description: Searches the rendered document and returns the first matching line and column, or [code](-1, -1)[/code] when there is no match.

method.name: select_all
method.description: Selects all rendered document text.

method.name: set_document
method.description: Sets the document resource to display.

method.name: set_context_menu_enabled
method.description: Sets whether the right-click context menu is enabled.

method.name: set_content_margin
method.description: Sets the uniform margin around the document content. Negative values are treated as zero.

method.name: set_access
method.description: Sets the default source for relative resource paths: project resources, user data, or the file system.

method.name: set_root_subfolder
method.description: Sets the root folder used to resolve relative paths when no source document directory is available.

method.name: set_deselect_on_focus_loss_enabled
method.description: Sets whether the current text selection is cleared when the control loses focus.

method.name: set_drag_and_drop_selection_enabled
method.description: Sets whether selected text can be dragged to Godot controls that accept text drag-and-drop data.

method.name: set_extra_font_size
method.description: Sets the additional font size applied to rendered text. The value is clamped to the range [code]0[/code] to [code]16[/code] and emits [signal extra_font_size_changed].

method.name: set_open_external_links
method.description: Sets whether activated HTTP and HTTPS links are opened with the system's default application.

method.name: set_selection_enabled
method.description: Sets whether rendered text can be selected. Disabling selection clears the current selection.

method.name: set_word_selection_mode
method.description: Sets the word boundary algorithm used for double-click text selection.

method.name: set_fit_content
method.description: Sets whether the control reports its rendered content height as its minimum height.

method.name: set_scroll_active
method.description: Sets whether the internal vertical scroll bar is active.

method.name: set_shortcut_keys_enabled
method.description: Sets whether the configured Copy and Select All keyboard shortcuts are enabled.

method.name: set_autowrap_mode
method.description: Sets how rendered text wraps inside the control bounds.

method.name: get_autowrap_mode
method.description: Returns how rendered text wraps inside the control bounds.

method.name: set_autowrap_trim_flags
method.description: Sets the line break space-trimming flags. Only trim flags are stored.

method.name: get_autowrap_trim_flags
method.description: Returns the line break space-trimming flags.

method.name: set_rst_text
method.description: Sets raw reStructuredText text to display and clears the current document resource.

method.name: get_h_scroll_bar
method.description: Returns the internal horizontal scroll bar.

method.name: get_v_scroll_bar
method.description: Returns the internal vertical scroll bar.

signal.name: link_pressed
signal.description: Emitted when a rendered link is activated.

signal.name: render_warning
signal.description: Emitted when the renderer encounters an unsupported directive or resource.
